assessments.summary: The pinned checker, certificate, and successful attested execution establish 152 distinct points in the 76×76 grid and exhaustively verify that every triple has nonzero determinant. Since the 76×76 grid embeds in the 77×77 grid, this proves D(77) ≥ 152.
scopeQualifications: Establishes only the existing lower bound D(77) ≥ 152, not optimality or an upper bound.
The attestation establishes one successful execution of the pinned request and artifacts, not that future or local executions will use identical infrastructure.
The assertion that the artifacts are byte-for-byte identical to transaction dfc0cc40d1193b8d5ca25e7f177fa48ff9a1b38d is not independently verified, but is unnecessary for the mathematical conclusion.
The described networkless and read-only execution properties are not independently confirmed by the summarized attestation and are unnecessary for the mathematical implication.
